title: 武将头像生成记录
generationMode: 内置 image_gen，逐角色引用当前立绘生成
style: 中国历史连环画墨线与哑光水粉，头肩近景、淡纸色背景、无文字和边框
commonPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE square 1:1 head-and-shoulders portrait icon for a Chinese Three Kingdoms strategy game, readable at 64px and delivered as a full square illustration.
Input image 1 is the exact character identity and painted style reference. Redraw as a dedicated close-up avatar of that SAME individual, preserving facial structure, age, skin tone, hair, facial hair, headwear, costume colour and distinctive personality. This is NOT a full body card or a collage.
Style: carefully hand-drawn Chinese historical illustrated-book artwork, tapered ink contours, restrained matte gouache washes and designed flat shadow shapes, subtle natural asymmetry. Follow the reference's line work and dry brush, but simplify small ornamental detail for thumbnail legibility. No airbrushed or photographic face.
Composition: face is the clear focal point, centered horizontally, eyes near 43% height, neck and upper shoulders visible across the lower quarter. Head including main headwear fills most of the upper area with modest top margin. Preserve an expressive individual three-quarter head turn, natural human expression. No hands, arms, weapons or props crossing the face. Simple warm pale stone / parchment field right to all four edges, extremely subtle paper, no scenery. No border: the game supplies the frame and may mask the square to a circle.
Lighting: restrained soft diffuse painted daylight in 2-3 values. Warm ivory, muted earthy accent colours, charcoal linework. Face and hair silhouettes must read instantly at tiny size.
Text: none. No name, letters, labels, watermark, frame, UI, glowing rim, cinematic effects, glossy gold, fantasy spikes, 3D/PBR, photorealism, beauty-filter skin, generic model face, extra people.
